dialogue.content: こんばんは。今日ロールプレイは20時からで大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. Is it alright to start the role-play at 8 PM today?

dialogue.content: もし開始時間等、遅れるとか不都合な点があれば教えて下さい。
dialogue.English: If there's any delay or issue with the start time, please let me know.

dialogue.content: 20時きたので、大丈夫なら開始お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's 8 PM now, so if you're ready, let's please begin.

dialogue.content: 一応、後５分待ちますね
dialogue.English: I'll wait another 5 minutes, just in case.

dialogue.content: SVの先生がこのロールプレイ画面を見ていたら、教えて欲しいのですが、ロールプレイの相手が入らなかった場合、レポート等はどうすればいいですか？
dialogue.English: If the supervisor is watching this role-play screen, I'd like to ask: if my role-play partner doesn't show up, what should I do about the report and so on?

dialogue.content: この様子だと、カウンセラー役の方が日程を忘れている可能性が高いです。そのままの事を書けばいいですか？
dialogue.English: From the looks of it, it's highly likely the counselor forgot the schedule. Should I just write exactly what happened?

dialogue.content: 相談員です。申し訳ありませんでした。
dialogue.English: This is the counselor. I am very sorry.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Are you okay?

dialogue.content: はい、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm ready to begin.

dialogue.content: 覚えていらっしゃるのでしたら、始めて下さい。
dialogue.English: If you're ready, please begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Likewise. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。ご相談いただきましてありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: This is the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 部活でいじめられてます。どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: I'm being bullied in my school club. What should I do?

dialogue.content: それは辛いですね。最初に学年と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: That sounds very difficult. To start, could you please tell me your grade and gender?

dialogue.content: 高1で男性です
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year high school student, male.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: 野球部に入っているけど、周りがすごすぎて、ついていけない
dialogue.English: I'm on the baseball team, but everyone around me is so good that I can't keep up.

dialogue.content: そう感じているのですね、詳しくお聞きしますが、いつからですか？？
dialogue.English: I see you're feeling that way. Could you tell me more, like when this started?

dialogue.content: 入って半年後位から
dialogue.English: About six months after I joined.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、悲しくなりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be disheartening.

dialogue.content: 中学ではレギュラーで、野球が好きだし、甲子園に行きたいと思って、高校も部活で選んだんです
dialogue.English: In middle school, I was a regular player. I love baseball and wanted to go to Koshien, so I chose my high school based on its baseball team.

dialogue.content: しかしレベルが高い
dialogue.English: But the level here is really high.

dialogue.content: ええ、以前もしていたのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so you were playing before as well.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: レベルが高いと感じるのはどのようなところからですか？
dialogue.English: In what ways do you feel the level is high?

dialogue.content: 今、レギュラーになっている人達は、プロ野球のスカウトが見に来るレベルなんです
dialogue.English: The current regulars are at a level where professional baseball scouts come to watch them.

dialogue.content: 技術もすごいし。
dialogue.English: Their skills are amazing, too.

dialogue.content: 入ったばかりは、自分もそうなりたいと思って、頑張った
dialogue.English: When I first joined, I wanted to be like them, so I worked hard.

dialogue.content: そんなにすごいんですね、そうですよね、
dialogue.English: They're that good, I see. Yes,

dialogue.content: 好きな野球ですものね、
dialogue.English: it's the baseball you love, after all.

dialogue.content: でも慣れるのに、時間がかかって、それでミスが多くなって。
dialogue.English: But it took me a while to get used to it, and I started making a lot of mistakes.

dialogue.content: それを責められた事がきっかけで、段々悪口とか始まって。
dialogue.English: Getting blamed for those mistakes was the trigger, and gradually people started bad-mouthing me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、頑張ってレギュラーになりたいと思いたのに悲しくなりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. You were working so hard to become a regular, so that must be heartbreaking.

dialogue.content: そんな成り行きがあったのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how it happened.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 悪口を3年のレギュラーの先輩が言い始めると、周りも言うようになって。
dialogue.English: When a third-year senior who's a regular started bad-mouthing me, everyone else started doing it too.

dialogue.content: やる気で入られたのに、本当に悲しくなりますね。しかも
dialogue.English: You joined with such motivation, so this must be truly painful. And on top of that—

dialogue.content: そのうち、対抗戦で負けたりすると、八つ当たりで物投げられるし。
dialogue.English: Eventually, when we'd lose a match against another school, they would take it out on me and throw things at me.

dialogue.content: しかも？
dialogue.English: And on top of that?

dialogue.content: あなたが悪いわけではないですのに。
dialogue.English: it's not your fault.

dialogue.content: そんなひどいことまで・・・
dialogue.English: That they'd go so far as to do such terrible things...

dialogue.content: 八つ当たりは僕のミスもちょっとあったけど、全体的に点が取れなかったんです。
dialogue.English: They took it out on me, and while I did make a few mistakes, the team as a whole couldn't score.

dialogue.content: ピッチャーの調子も悪かったけど、周りのサポートもうまくなくて。
dialogue.English: The pitcher wasn't in good form, and the support from the rest of the team wasn't great either.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、でも野球は
dialogue.English: I see... but baseball is—

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: チームプレーですから誰かが悪いわけではないことですよね。
dialogue.English: a team sport, so it's not any single person's fault, is it?

dialogue.content: 顧問の先生にも1度相談したけど、かわされた感じで。
dialogue.English: I talked to the faculty advisor once, but it felt like he just brushed me off.

dialogue.content: グローブも隠されたりしたから。
dialogue.English: They even hid my glove once.

dialogue.content: 後からすぐに出てきたけど。
dialogue.English: It turned up soon after, though.

dialogue.content: あまりおおごとにすると、大会出られなくなるし、そっちの方が困るから
dialogue.English: If I make a big deal out of it, we might not be able to compete in the tournament, and that would be an even bigger problem.

dialogue.content: 先生におっしゃったのに、気持ちを受け入れてもらえないなんて
dialogue.English: Even though you spoke to the advisor, to think your feelings weren't acknowledged...

dialogue.content: 3年の先輩とかプロに行くか進学するか、将来かかっているし。
dialogue.English: For the third-year seniors, their futures are on the line—whether they go pro or to college.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それもチームとしては大切なことかもしれませんが
dialogue.English: That's true, and that may be important for the team, but...

dialogue.content: 先輩が卒業したら、また変わるかもしれないけど、それまで持つかどうか…
dialogue.English: Things might change after the seniors graduate, but I don’t know if I can last until then...

dialogue.content: あなたの気持ちが悲しすぎます。
dialogue.English: It's just so heartbreaking to hear how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 同じ様な同級生が入部当初いたけど、結局辞めました。
dialogue.English: There was a classmate in a similar situation when I first joined, but he ended up quitting.

dialogue.content: 辞めやれたひともあるのですね、そんな辛いのに
dialogue.English: So another person quit... It shows just how painful it is, and yet you're still enduring it.

dialogue.content: 同級生が辞めた後、こっちに矛先が向いた感じ。
dialogue.English: After my classmate quit, it felt like the target shifted to me.

dialogue.content: 野球は好きだけど、部活は辛い。
dialogue.English: I love baseball, but being on the team is painful.

dialogue.content: あなたはよく我慢していますね。
dialogue.English: You’ve been enduring so much.

dialogue.content: そろそろ限界な気もしています
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm reaching my limit.

dialogue.content: そんなに辛くても、続けているあなたがとても立派です。
dialogue.English: It's admirable that you're continuing on even though it's so painful.

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: のびのびプレイしたいけど、それも出来ないし
dialogue.English: I want to play freely, but I can't even do that.

dialogue.content: 自分らしいプレイが出来ない
dialogue.English: I can't play like myself.

dialogue.content: そのようにお見受けします、
dialogue.English: It certainly sounds that way.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 頑張りたくてももどかしいあなたの気持ちがすごく伝わってきますね。
dialogue.English: I can really feel your frustration, of wanting to try your best but not being able to.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大切なこれからのことを一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Let's think about your important future together.

dialogue.content: …相談員さんだったら、どうしますか？
dialogue.English: ...If you were in my position, what would you do?

dialogue.content: 親には心配かけたく内から、言えてないです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to tell my parents because I don’t want to worry them.

dialogue.content: 私立だから、お金もかかっているし。
dialogue.English: It's a private school, so it costs a lot of money, too.

dialogue.content: 優しいあなたですから言えないのでしょうね。
dialogue.English: You're such a kind person, so I imagine it's hard for you to tell them.

dialogue.content: 優しいんですか…
dialogue.English: Am I kind...?

dialogue.content: 弱いからではなく
dialogue.English: And not because I'm weak?

dialogue.content: ええ、ご両親のことを気にかけておられまsすものね、一度整理させていただいてもいいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Yes, because you're considerate of your parents. Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize things?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは大好きな野球部にはいられて、レギュラーになることを楽しみに頑張って練習してこられたのに
dialogue.English: You joined the baseball team you love and have been practicing hard, looking forward to becoming a regular, but...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 高校入学後半年ぐらいたってから、レベルの高さや自分の実力がないのではないか
dialogue.English: about six months after starting high school, you started to feel that the level was too high and that perhaps you weren't skilled enough.

dialogue.content: ないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think I am.

dialogue.content: という気持ちと同時に周囲からのいじめに苦しんでおられる。自分で選んだ高校ですから
dialogue.English: And at the same time, you've been suffering from bullying from those around you. Since it's the high school you chose yourself...

dialogue.content: 期待してました
dialogue.English: I had high hopes.

dialogue.content: ご両親にも辛さや本音が言えず、でも野球が好きな気持ちは変わらない
dialogue.English: you can't tell your parents how much you're struggling or how you really feel, but your love for baseball hasn't changed.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これからも続けたいし、チームの一員として
dialogue.English: You want to continue playing, as a member of the team,

dialogue.content: 野球はしたいし、甲子園にも行きたいです
dialogue.English: I want to play baseball, and I want to go to Koshien.

dialogue.content: 認めてもらいたい。
dialogue.English: and you want to be acknowledged.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたはとてもやる気があり、
dialogue.English: You are very motivated,

dialogue.content: ご両親の気持ちを考えることができる広い心をお持ちです。
dialogue.English: and you have a big heart that allows you to consider your parents' feelings.

dialogue.content: きっとチームのことをいつも真剣に考えているかたと思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine you’re someone who always thinks seriously about the team.

dialogue.content: チームというか、自分がレギュラーになって、野球がしたいんです
dialogue.English: It's not so much about the team... I want to become a regular and play baseball.

dialogue.content: でも、このチームの雰囲気はあまり良くない
dialogue.English: But the atmosphere on this team isn't very good.

dialogue.content: レギュラーになりたいと思われているのですね。
dialogue.English: So you want to become a regular.

dialogue.content: しんどい
dialogue.English: It’s tough.

dialogue.content: レギュラーにならないと意味ないし
dialogue.English: There's no point if I'm not a regular.

dialogue.content: 甲子園でプレイしたい
dialogue.English: I want to play at Koshien.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 甲子園に出たいですよね。
dialogue.English: You want to make it to Koshien.

dialogue.content: あなたの意欲がすごく伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: Your drive really comes through.

dialogue.content: ではレギュラーになるためにどうすればよいか考えましょう。
dialogue.English: Then let's think about what you can do to become a regular.

dialogue.content: 練習するのみです
dialogue.English: All I can do is practice.

dialogue.content: 実力つけて。
dialogue.English: And build my skills.

dialogue.content: そうですね、練習のみですよね。
dialogue.English: That's right, practice is the only way.

dialogue.content: 試合で沢山いいプレイして。
dialogue.English: Make a lot of good plays in games.

dialogue.content: それ以外に何かありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else?

dialogue.content: でもあなたは野球はそのためだけにしてこられたのですか？
dialogue.English: But is that the only reason you've played baseball?

dialogue.content: あなたは野球のどこが好きですか？
dialogue.English: What do you love about baseball?

dialogue.content: …チームで皆で色々出来る事かな。
dialogue.English: ...I guess it's doing all sorts of things together as a team.

dialogue.content: プレイがうまく行けば嬉しいし。
dialogue.English: It feels great when a play goes well.

dialogue.content: 助けあったり。
dialogue.English: And helping each other out.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、助け合うなんて素敵ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Helping each other out is a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: 中学の時は、お互いをサポートしあってたけど、今はそれがない
dialogue.English: In middle school, we all supported each other, but we don't have that now.

dialogue.content: あなたは以前はそうしていたのに
dialogue.English: And you used to have that.

dialogue.content: 何ていうか…気持よりも技術が全てみたいな感じ
dialogue.English: How should I put it... It feels like skill is everything, more than team spirit.

dialogue.content: 今はそれがないことが悲しく思われたり、
dialogue.English: and you feel sad that it’s missing now.

dialogue.content: うまけりゃいいみたいな
dialogue.English: It's like, as long as you're skilled, that's all that matters.

dialogue.content: それがないことにしっかり気が付いておられますね。
dialogue.English: You've clearly noticed that it's missing.

dialogue.content: 寂しい感じはするけど、実際勝たないと意味ないし
dialogue.English: It feels lonely, but in reality, there's no point if you don't win.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、勝敗は野球の醍醐味でもあると思います。
dialogue.English: That's true. Winning and losing is part of the thrill of baseball, after all.

dialogue.content: 強さってそういう物なのかなと、高校入って思いました
dialogue.English: After getting to high school, I started to think that maybe that's what strength is.

dialogue.content: 勝つと嬉しいけど
dialogue.English: Winning feels good, but...

dialogue.content: 仲間と何もないのも、寂しいんです
dialogue.English: having no connection with my teammates is lonely, too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、勝つことに力を入れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You end up focusing all your energy on winning.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 実力が全てな感じ
dialogue.English: It feels like skill is everything.

dialogue.content: それは当然のことと思います。
dialogue.English: I think that's perfectly natural.

dialogue.content: でもあなたがなぜ野球が好きになられたのか、
dialogue.English: But the reason why you came to love baseball,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: また勝敗だけでなく、練習やチーム作りや
dialogue.English: and not just winning or losing, but also practice, team-building,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周囲との助け合いなど、たくさんのことが集まって野球があるのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: and helping those around you—perhaps baseball is a collection of all those many things.

dialogue.content: 僕はそういう野球の方が好きです
dialogue.English: I like that kind of baseball better.

dialogue.content: 僕が受験する年は、そんな感じだったけど、顧問の先生が変わってから、雰囲気が変わったみたいで。
dialogue.English: It was like that the year I was taking my entrance exams, but it seems the atmosphere changed after the faculty advisor changed.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、あなたが好きな野球をあなたの考え方で
dialogue.English: Thank you. The baseball you love, played in your own way,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やってみていただけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: I hope you'll be able to play it.

dialogue.content: 今のままで続けられるかどうか、自信がありません
dialogue.English: I'm not confident I can continue on as things are now.

dialogue.content: 続けられる方法はありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a way for me to continue?

dialogue.content: チームという考え方を大切にして、
dialogue.English: By valuing the idea of a team,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 監督や同級生に働きかけていくことが良いのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it would be a good idea to try and reach out to the coach and your classmates.

dialogue.content: 自分1人で出来ますか？
dialogue.English: Can I do that by myself?

dialogue.content: 余計いじめられませんか？
dialogue.English: Won't that just make the bullying worse?

dialogue.content: 同級生のチームの友達に言うことはできませんか？
dialogue.English: Could you talk to any of your teammates who are in your grade?

dialogue.content: 難しいです
dialogue.English: That's difficult.

dialogue.content: 変に関わると、先輩から色々言われるみたいだから。
dialogue.English: Because it seems like if they get involved with me, the seniors will give them a hard time.

dialogue.content: 先生も力になってくれなかったとおっしゃっていましたね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned the faculty advisor wasn't helpful either.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: キャプテンに言うこともできないですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be possible to talk to the captain?

dialogue.content: 難しいんです
dialogue.English: It's difficult.

dialogue.content: そんなに厳しい環境なんですね。キャプテンに言えないのはなぜでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's that harsh of an environment, I see. Why do you feel you can't talk to the captain?

dialogue.content: キャブテンもいう方だから。
dialogue.English: Because the captain is one of the ones who says those things.

dialogue.content: 味方がはっきり言っていないんです
dialogue.English: To put it plainly, I don't have any allies.

dialogue.content: 言ってみるとどうなりそうですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think would happen if you did try to say something?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 言わずに辛さを我慢しながら今の状態を続けるのとキャプテンか先生に言ってみるのとどちらがいいですか？
dialogue.English: Which do you think is better: continuing in this painful situation while holding it all in, or trying to talk to the captain or the advisor?

dialogue.content: わからないから、相談に来ています
dialogue.English: I don't know. That's why I've come to you for counseling.

dialogue.content: 大好きな野球をあなたが精いっぱいできるようになってほしいと思います。そのために勇気を出してみるのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I want you to be able to play the baseball you love to your fullest. To make that happen, how about trying to muster up some courage?

dialogue.content: 結構ハードル高いです
dialogue.English: That's a pretty high hurdle.

dialogue.content: 難しい感じですね、好きな野球を続けていっていただきたいと思います。長時間になり申し訳ありませんでした。言い足りないと思いますが本日は終了させていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It sounds difficult. I do hope you can continue playing the baseball you love. I'm sorry this has taken so long. I'm sure there's more you'd like to say, but would it be alright if we finished for today?

dialogue.content: いいです
dialogue.English: That's fine.

dialogue.content: 僕も用事があるので、そろそろ止めようと思っていました
dialogue.English: I have other things to do as well, so I was thinking of stopping soon anyway.

dialogue.content: お気遣いいただきありがとうございます。本日はご相談いただきましてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your consideration, and thank you again for your consultation today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: またご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to reach out again. Thank you.

dialogue.content: （出だし、申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.English: (Again, my apologies for the late start.)

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
